summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release on FDA priority review acceptance for its investigational drug venglustat to treat type 3 Gaucher disease. The filing describes the regulatory milestone and clinical data but does not involve any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC transaction. It is a routine regulatory update with no special-situation deal terms.
